purpose: Approved icon style reference; individual production icons are not yet exported.
originalPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: preview-only icon concept board for Hammill Add-ins, a professional Solid Edge CAD add-in suite.
Create a polished wide landscape icon-design comparison sheet showing ONE coherent design direction: "B — Shaded CAD". Pure white background, comfortable whitespace. Header text exact: "HAMMILL ADD-INS". Subheader exact: "B — Shaded CAD".
A single perfectly aligned horizontal row of FIVE evenly spaced large icons with exact short labels below each. No cards, no rounded app-tile backgrounds, no wallpaper. Style: traditional professional CAD toolbar artwork, restrained isometric depth, gentle bevels, subtle metallic/material shading, strong clean silhouettes and restrained color. Keep complexity low enough for readable 24–32 pixel ribbon icons. No photorealistic scenes, no glossy toy appearance, no excessive shadows. Use steel gray, restrained blue, and conventional pencil/plus accents, coherent as a family.
Icons from left to right:
1. Label "O-Ring Finder". A dark rubber torus viewed slightly obliquely, central hole visible, with a small blue-handled magnifying glass lower right. Distinguish torus from lens rim.
2. Label "Add Sketch". A tilted sketch plane with a simple line sketch, a short drafting pencil and a clear plus sign.
3. Label "Occurrence Viewer". Three small shaded assembly blocks connected by a simple hierarchy, with an eye glyph.
4. Label "Batch Export". Two slightly layered drawing sheets, minimal drafting marks, and a thick outward/right export arrow.
5. Label "Hammill". A compact machined capital H monogram, beveled steel edges and blue face, no invented official company logo claims.
Show one enlarged icon above each label, and a second smaller rendition of the SAME icon below the label to suggest toolbar use. Small rendition is a visual preview, not a claimed pixel-perfect output. No extra controls or icons. Absolutely no Component Display icon. This is a concept review sheet, not final production assets. Crisp, balanced and professional. All text legible and correctly spelled.
